comments.author: participant12
comments.body:
The problem is line 9 of `android/build.gradle`. Kotlin version was incremented to 1.9.25.
```
kotlinVersion = findProperty('android.kotlinVersion') ?: '1.9.25'
```

We missed this cause we're not using prebuild yet and the [Native project upgrade helper](https://docs.expo.dev/bare/upgrade/?fromSdk=51&toSdk=52) still says that it should be `'1.9.24'`. Even running `npx expo prebuild` doesn't correct this line in our project. We had to create a fresh project and run prebuild to even figure this out.

inside `android/build.gradle` under `buildscript.dependencies`.

comments.body: I have similar issue, I am using Expo 52.0.36 After hours of tinkering, I found the issue came from this section of the expo-module-core build.gradle file ``` if (KOTLIN_MAJOR_VERSION < 2) { composeOptions { def versionsMap = [ "1.9.24": "1.5.14", "1.9.25": "1.5.15", ] kotlinCompilerExtensionVersion = versionsMap[kotlinVersion()] } } ``` I wasn't able to determine where `kotlinVersion()` was declared. I hardcoded the Kotlin version and I stopped having the error ``` kotlinCompilerExtensionVersion = versionsMap["1.9.25"] ``` I am currently trying to set `kotlinCompilerExtensionVersion` from the project's app level. I hope this helps with your patch. ### Edit I couldn't work with the hardcoded kotlin compiler extension version because I needed to use expo-updates. After further tinkering, I was able to resolve the issue by setting `kotlinCompilerExtensionVersion=1.5.15` (I am using kotlin 1.9.25) in `gradle.properties` I hope this helps you.

comments.body:
I solved it by following these steps:

In your `android/app/build.gradle`, add the following block:

```
composeOptions {
    def versionsMap = [
      "1.9.24": "1.5.14",
      "1.9.25": "1.5.15",
    ]
    kotlinCompilerExtensionVersion = versionsMap["1.9.25"]
}
```

In your `android/build.gradle`, add `classpath('org.jetbrains.kotlin:kotlin-gradle-plugin:1.9.25')` within the dependencies block.

In your `android/gradle.properties`, add the following line:

`android.kotlinVersion=1.9.25`

I'm using Expo 52.0.19 and React Native 0.76.7.

This worked for me (`expo 52.0.36`):
```
npx expo install --check

npx expo install expo-build-properties
```
In app.json, add:
```json
{
  "expo": {
   ...
    "plugins": [
      [
        "expo-build-properties",
        {
          "android": {
            "compileSdkVersion": 35,
            "targetSdkVersion": 34,
            "buildToolsVersion": "35.0.0",
            "kotlinVersion": "1.9.25"
          }
        }
      ]
   ...
    ],
```

Then run:
```
npx expo prebuild --platform android
npx expo run:android
```
It should work!

comments.body:
I faced the same issue and none of the suggested solutions worked. As a workaround, I created a small **plugin** that patches the version so it stays consistent in upcoming generative builds.

**Steps to apply the fix:**

1. Add the attached file to your project under `plugins/`.
2. Update your `app.json` as follows:

   ```json
   {
     "expo": {
       "plugins": [
         "./plugins/update-compose-compiler.js"
       ]
     }
   }
   ```
3. Rebuild your app:

   ```bash
   rm -rf android
   npx expo prebuild --clean
   cd android
   ./gradlew assembleDebug
   ```

I was able to trace the issue by running:

```bash
./gradlew buildEnvironment
```

which showed that the version I had specified in the build was being overridden, e.g.:

```
\--- org.jetbrains.kotlin:kotlin-gradle-plugin:1.7.20 -> 1.9.25 (*)
```

[update-compose-compiler.js](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/21950854/update-compose-compiler.js)
